title: The Goblin Cellar
about: Combat and magic: a band of goblins has dug into a farmhouse cellar. Drive them out.

goblins.title: Goblins Under the Floor
goblins.offer: Goblins! They tunnelled into my cellar two nights ago. Get them out of there and the coin in my strongbox is yours: 50 gold.
goblins.done: Edda opens her strongbox with shaking hands.

farmhouse.name: Edda's Farmhouse
farmhouse.text: A low farmhouse kitchen. The farmer, Edda, has barricaded the cellar door with a table, and something scratches on the other side.

people.name: Edda
people.text: A grey-haired farmer holding a pitchfork.

stairs.name: The Cellar Stairs
stairs.text: Narrow stairs into the dark, littered with broken crockery.

cellar.name: The Goblin Cellar
cellar.text: Shelves of preserves have been knocked over. Two goblins in scavenged mail and a pair of scrawny ones squat around a stolen ham.
